title: CmdPal: Redesign the Performance Monitor Battery card

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The resource-bounded literal-candidate retry completed with build exit 1 despite single-node MSBuild and reduced dependency concurrency. MIDL could not open its response file and CsWinRT exited 0xC0000409. No tests ran. A bounded saved-log investigation confirmed the MIDL response existed before and after the build with unchanged content, but the generator child working directory was not captured. Long-path handling remains a hypothesis, not a proven cause; the CsWinRT response was removed during cleanup and no crash stack survived. A distinct targeted generator investigation is queued. Suggestions remain withheld, eight review requests are consumed, and no upstream-author defect or approval is inferred.
